CANopenObject.name: EV1
CANopenObject.description: This Object stores all the parameters relative to the control of Valve-A (EV1). The value are UINT16 and saved to Object dictionary EEPROM. Can be accessed read-write by SDO 0x2102.

CANopenSubObject.name: Ifull
CANopenSubObject.description: This is the valve FULL CURRENT setting, expressed in mA.

CANopenSubObject.name: Ioffs
CANopenSubObject.description: This is the valve OFFSET CURRENT setting, expressed in mA.

CANopenSubObject.name: RampUp
CANopenSubObject.description: Current Linear Ramp steepness (rising), expressed in mA/s.

CANopenSubObject.name: RampDw
CANopenSubObject.description: Current Linear Ramp steepness (falling), expressed in mA/s.

CANopenSubObject.name: Dither
CANopenSubObject.description: Dither Factor superimposed to the valve current. Value expressed in % of the valve current. Dither default frequency is 125 Hz.

CANopenSubObject.name: ConvADC
CANopenSubObject.description: Conversion factor between ADC scale (decimal unit) and current value in mA. This value can be corrected with manual calibration during normal operation.

CANopenSubObject.name: NotLinCoef
CANopenSubObject.description: Compensation of the non linearities of the filter for current reading. Deprecated in october 2023.

CANopenSubObject.name: SysMode
CANopenSubObject.description:
Valve reference MODE:
- MODE_AN_0_10V: // ANALOG - MODE 1 - 0V TO 10 V - MODE_AN_0_5V: // ANALOG - MODE 2 - 0V TO 5 V - MODE_AN_5_0V: // ANALOG - MODE 3 - 5V TO 0 V - MODE_AN_5_10V: // ANALOG - MODE 4 - 5V TO 10 V - MODE_DGT: // DIGITAL- MODE 5 - CAN CONTROLLED

CANopenSubObject.name: ZeroOffs
CANopenSubObject.description: Zero Offset setting used to bypass offset current by setting valve current to zero until setpoint is reached. Setpoint value is expressed in % of the input scale. E.G. with 16 bit digital input, zero current is set until % of the 26bit input value is reached.

CANopenSubObject.name: CANBits
CANopenSubObject.description: Number of bits of resolution of the digital reference received over CAN BUS.

CANopenSubObject.name: CAN_CH
CANopenSubObject.description:
Digital Input used fro controlling the valve with CAN messages.
With MASTER: The valve is controlled by a controller device with the same ID. RXPDO Mapping over Slot 0x1400.
- MASTER CH1 --> 0 - (SubID 0-1): reference channel 1 (max 16 bit) - MASTER CH2 --> 1 - (SubID 2-3): reference channel 2 (max 16 bit)
With EXTERNAL, the device can be controller by any other CANopen device available on the network. - EXTERNAL DEV --> 2

CANopenSubObject.name: CAN_ID_TARGET_DEV
CANopenSubObject.description: CAN OPEN ID to listend when DIGITAL MODE is on. CAN ID can go from 1 to 127.

CANopenSubObject.name: CAN_TARGET_FIELD
CANopenSubObject.description: Sub-Index of the CAN OPEN PDO packet where the data is sent from the external device (0 to 7) byte.

CANopenSubObject.name: DIG_DW_REF
CANopenSubObject.description: Digital value sent on from the external CAN device corresponding to Offset Current.

CANopenSubObject.name: DIG_UP_REF
CANopenSubObject.description: Digital value sent on from the external CAN device corresponding to Full Current.

CANopenObject.name: NodeID
CANopenObject.description: The node ID (address) of a CANopen device must be within the range from 1 to 127. The communication object identifier (COB-ID) is directly dependent on the selected node ID.

CANopenObject.name: SysConfig
CANopenObject.description: This object indicates features that are available on the controller board. The MODEL of the controller is set at programming level and cannot be changed. All the sub-objects here therefore are read-only.

EV_NUMBER
CANopenSubObject.description: Number of available PWM output for current valve control.

CANopenSubObject.name: ADC_VSUPPLY

CANopenObject.name: Date_Infos

CANopenObject.name: AnalogOutput
CANopenObject.description:
This Object is mapped to TX PDO slot 0x1800 using all 8 bytes. This object is used to send real-time reading of the following entities:
1. Iread_EV1 (16 bit)- current reading on EV1 in mA 2. Iread_EV2 (16 bit)- current reading on EV2 in mA 3. Vread_Ext (16 bit)- voltage reading on external reference in mV (-123 if not Available) 4. Vread_Spp (16 bit)- supply voltage reading in mV (-123 if not Available)

CANopenObject.name: AnalogInput
CANopenObject.description:
Enable digital control from CAN Master channel (2 CH - 16bits).
This object can be used to test the system by controlling output current through CAN RX-PDO messages. RXPDO Mapping over Slot 0x1400.
- CH1_Ref (SubID 0-1): reference channel 1 (max 16 bit) - CH2_Ref (SubID 2-3): reference channel 2 (max 16 bit)

CANopenObject.name: ErrorOutput
CANopenObject.description:
Documentation for Error Messages
Error Messages are sent through TXPDO (TPDO[1]) every 100 ms. TXPDO[1] use 3 bytes to send three types of error: Errors on EV1, EV2 and errors on DIGITAL Output. Each variable is a UINT8. ErrorOutput is a RAM only variables array with read-only capability.
See each variable description for more details.

CANopenSubObject.name: ErrorEV1
CANopenSubObject.description:
TXPDO Mapping on Slot 0x1801 SubID 0. Bit Position: Error Type
4: VSUPPLY_ERR 3: CAN_BUS_ERR 2: CC_ERR 1: OC_ERR 0: I_MAX_ERR
The error message is constructed by evaluating the corresponding bit positions in the error variables and assigning the appropriate values to each bit. By checking the state of these bits, you can determine which specific errors are present in the system.
VSUPPLY_ERR: Supply Voltage Error
Bit position: 4 Description: Represents an error related to the supply voltage. It indicates that there is an issue with the power supply voltage for the valve. CAN_BUS_ERR: CAN Bus Connection Error
Bit position: 3 Description: Represents an error related to the CAN bus connection. It indicates that there is a problem with the communication on the CAN bus, which is used for data exchange between devices. CC_ERR: Short Circuit Error
Bit position: 2 Description: Represents an error related to a short circuit. It indicates that a short circuit has been detected in the valve circuitry or wiring. OC_ERR: Open Circuit Error
Bit position: 1 Description: Represents an error related to an open circuit. It indicates that an open circuit has been detected in the valve circuitry or wiring, causing a loss of continuity. I_MAX_ERR: Maximum Current Reached Error
Bit position: 0 Description: Represents an error related to the maximum current threshold being reached. It indicates that the current flowing through the valve has exceeded the specified maximum limit.

CANopenSubObject.name: ErrorEV2
CANopenSubObject.description:
TXPDO Mapping on Slot 0x1801 SubID 1. Bit Position: Error Type
4: VSUPPLY_ERR 3: CAN_BUS_ERR 2: CC_ERR 1: OC_ERR 0: I_MAX_ERR
The error message is constructed by evaluating the corresponding bit positions in the error variables and assigning the appropriate values to each bit. By checking the state of these bits, you can determine which specific errors are present in the system.
VSUPPLY_ERR: Supply Voltage Error
Bit position: 4 Description: Represents an error related to the supply voltage. It indicates that there is an issue with the power supply voltage for the valve. CAN_BUS_ERR: CAN Bus Connection Error
Bit position: 3 Description: Represents an error related to the CAN bus connection. It indicates that there is a problem with the communication on the CAN bus, which is used for data exchange between devices. CC_ERR: Short Circuit Error
Bit position: 2 Description: Represents an error related to a short circuit. It indicates that a short circuit has been detected in the valve circuitry or wiring. OC_ERR: Open Circuit Error
Bit position: 1 Description: Represents an error related to an open circuit. It indicates that an open circuit has been detected in the valve circuitry or wiring, causing a loss of continuity. I_MAX_ERR: Maximum Current Reached Error
Bit position: 0 Description: Represents an error related to the maximum current threshold being reached. It indicates that the current flowing through the valve has exceeded the specified maximum limit.

CANopenSubObject.name: ErrorDigital
CANopenSubObject.description:
TXPDO Mapping on Slot 0x1801 SubID 2. Object for digital Output Error Signaling. Used only if Number of digital output available is > 0. Each bits indicates if a specific digital output detects Short Circuit or not.
0b01 - Short Circuit detected. 0b00 - No short circuit detected.
E.g.
ErrorDigital= 0b00100100 Short circuit detected on digital output [3] and [6].

CANopenObject.name: DigitalOutput
CANopenObject.description:
Object for digital Output Values Feedback. Used only if Number of digital output available is > 0. Each bits indicates if a specific digital output is active or not.
TXPDO Mapping over Slot 0x1802 - SubID 0.
0b01 - Digital Output Active 0b00 - Digital Output Not Active
E.g.
DigitalOutput = 0b00100100 Digital output [3] and [6] are active.

CANopenObject.name: DigitalInput
CANopenObject.description:
Object for digital Output Values Control. Used only if Number of digital output available is > 0. Each bits operates on a specific digital output to activate or deactivate it. RXPDO Mapping over Slot 0x1402 subID 1.
0b01 - Activate Digital Output 0b00 - Deactivate Digital Output
E.g.
DigitalOutput = 0b00100100 Digital output [3] and [6] are active.
